fusions.name: Plunge After It
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to a target and plunges in after it, dealing 14 damage, leaving it [Soaked] for 8 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Bites a target at or below 25% health, which deals 20 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Rallied Flock
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Pond Retriever
fusions.desc: A bonded retriever fights beside you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 4 health.
